notes: Positive: schema design, migration planning, data contract, indexes/partitions, lineage, access-pattern audit, schema review. Negative: engine choice (architect), execute migration (developer), code review (code-reviewer), test strategy (QE), threat-model PII (security), operate the store (SRE/platform). Edge: hybrid asks (schema + engine), feature planning that needs schema work (code-planner leads, data-engineer consulted), execution requests masquerading as design.
